name: gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct

usage_examples.title: Embed text
usage_examples.code:

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct", "input": ["search query text"]}'
